title: Fenn, the stockade prisoner at Camp Gallows whose dug-up muster rolls led me to the true, unsent pardon exonerating the Hanged Company, has zero reaction dialogue after I chose to burn the Gallows Glade instead of reading that pardon. He has no new topic and no acknowledgment that the exoneration he risked his neck to uncover was destroyed. Captain Vane and even Sergeant Coe (dicing stopped) reacted; the character most invested in the outcome did not.
where: The Stockade (Fenn) after burning The Gallows Glade
